summary.text: Marcus Evans has represented the 33rd District in the Illinois House of Representatives since April 2012.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Evans was born in Chicago, where Evans lives, and is a graduate of Chicago Public Schools and Morgan Park High School.
Evans earned a B.S. in business administration from Chicago State University and was formerly deputy chief of staff in the Chicago City Council office for the 8th Ward.
The biography also lists Evans as a licensed real estate appraiser.
